companies.name: Waniwani
companies.description: Revenue infrastructure for AI
companies.funding_notes: Verified waniwani.ai (company blog). San Francisco-based revenue/compliance infrastructure for agentic distribution of financial services; incubated by venture studio Hexa (HX26). Announced $8M seed on 2026-06-15 led by Seedcamp with Redstone, Plug & Play, Zone II Ventures, OPRTRS Club, Kima Ventures and angels. No other priced rounds found.

companies.name: Eversettled
companies.description: AI copilot for the legal, financial, and administrative process of settling an estate
companies.funding_notes: EverSettled (eversettled.com), San Francisco-based AI estate-settlement/probate platform founded via Entrepreneurs First (Arum Kempster, CEO). Raised $5M seed announced 2026-07-16 led by Emergence Capital with Seedcamp, Bridge Ventures, Alumni Ventures, Entrepreneurs First, Transpose Platform and angels. Domain matched via Seedcamp/Emergence coverage of the same company.

companies.name: Resolyst
companies.description: AI-enabled management of chronic disease through specialist networks
companies.funding_notes: Resolyst (resolyst.com), UK AI continuous specialty-care platform founded by Dr Molly Gilmartin (ex-Albion VC). Raised a $3M pre-seed (reported ~June 2026) co-led by Calm/Storm Ventures and Seedcamp (Calm/Storm also names Pact VC as co-lead) with AlbionVC, Scrub Capital, Day1.vc and angels; founder also cites support from Founder Labs and Invest Northern Ireland. Won HLTH Europe startup pitch ($30k cash and benefits, a prize not an equity round). No seed or later round found. Domain not explicitly shown in sources but name/description match.

companies.name: Penelope Health
companies.description: The infrastructure layer for US medical payments

funding_rounds.stage: Strategic funding commitment (round type not disclosed)

companies.funding_notes: Verified penelope.health (company newsroom). Penelope Health Inc. (Delaware, founders Sohum Patel and Mattijs De Paepe) is a real-time payer/provider policy intelligence platform. Pre-seed earlier in 2026 led by BHI with Twine Ventures and Seedcamp; an April 2026 SEC Form D (per DevCuration) recorded $2.725M sold of $2.9M via options/warrants/rights (SAFE-like), investor identities not in filing, and it is not confirmed that this equals the BHI pre-seed. On 2026-09-17 announced partnership with Thoreau (Matt Holt) and a $100M funding commitment led by Thoreau with BHI, Twine and Seedcamp; the company calls it a 'commitment' with no round name (Axios/Seedcamp say 'raised'). A Form D filed 2026-09-30 (first sale 2026-09-17) shows $24,999,998 of equity sold, so the $100M may be disbursed over time. Marked unclear-round-type because no round stage is public; amount_raised is the announced $100M commitment, not confirmed wired equity.

companies.name: Telemachus
companies.description: Telemachus creates AI-native competitors to poorly-run incumbent companies
companies.funding_notes: Telemachus (telemachus.io), London-based company that builds AI-native competitors to incumbents. Its own job posting says it went from 0 to >$10m annualised revenue in 11 months and 'raised various millions from VCs', but no amount, round type or investor list (other than Seedcamp, 2026) is public. No press release found.

companies.name: Opereit
companies.description: AI operating layer for transportation spend
companies.funding_notes: Opereit (opereit.ai), Barcelona-based AI agents that audit transport invoices and file carrier claims (founder Pablo Cousin, ex-REVER). Raised $2.5M (reported as €2.2M by Startup.eu) on 2026-06-03, co-led by Seedcamp and Yellow (Glovo founders' fund) with Baobab Ventures, Kima Ventures, Enzo Ventures, OPRTRS and angel Dídac Lee. Caveat: Seedcamp calls it a seed round, but Invest in Spain describes it as pre-seed and Startup.eu as 'unspecified'; classified seed+ on the lead investor's wording.

companies.name: Lupin & Holmes
companies.description: Offensive security for software supply-chain risk

investors: founders of Wiz, Hugging Face and GitGuardian (angels)

companies.funding_notes: Lupin & Holmes (landh.tech), founded by bug bounty hunter Roni Carta, builds Depi for software supply-chain offensive security. Raised a $5.9M pre-seed (Tech.eu, 2026-03-17) co-led by 20VC and Seedcamp with Purple Fund, Kima Ventures and angel founders of Wiz, Hugging Face and GitGuardian. No seed or later round found.

companies.name: sherpa
companies.description: AI operating system for external workforce management
companies.funding_notes: Verified sherpahq.ai (company announcement page). Munich/Germany-based AI operating system for external workforce management. Raised a $2.2M pre-seed (Tech.eu, 2026-07-09) from Seedcamp, DN Capital, Activant and Brighteye plus operator angels (Tech.eu describes them as co-leads). No seed or later round found.

companies.name: Pair
companies.description: The AI adoption layer for the enterprise
companies.funding_notes: PAIR (pairnow.ai), UK enterprise AI-adoption platform founded by Dr James Kuht MBE and Mark James Mitchell (ex-military technologists); customers include PwC, Ministry of Justice and The Crown Estate. Raised a seed round announced 2026-01-27 from Seedcamp and Venrex with FJ Labs; amount not disclosed (the '£1M' figure in some summaries is the company's ARR run rate, not the round size). Lead not explicitly named; company says it was profitable before raising. URLs list includes a LinkedIn post only as a pointer, not relied upon.

companies.name: Uncovr
companies.description: Transforming surgical video into documentation
companies.funding_notes: Uncovr (uncovr.ai), surgical AI turning surgical/endoscopic video into operative reports and coding recommendations; founded 2025 by Ines Iraki, Johann Diep and Prof. Eric Vibert (France/EU, working with US and European hospitals; Moon Surgical integration). Raised $7M seed (Tech.eu 2026-06-10) led by Index Ventures with Seedcamp, Frst, No Label Ventures, Entrepreneurs First and operator angels.

companies.name: Tattvam
companies.description: The AI layer for chip design
companies.funding_notes: Tattvam AI (tattvamlabs.ai), London-based AI for chip design (CEO Bragadeesh, co-founder Lannan Jiang). Emerged from stealth 2026-02-25 with $1.7M pre-seed led by Seedcamp with EWOR, Entropy Industrial Ventures, Concept Ventures and angel Stan Boland. No seed or later round found.

companies.name: Revox
companies.description: Voice AI infrastructure to grow your revenue
companies.funding_notes: Revox (getrevox.com), Paris-founded developer-first voice AI API for outbound calls (founders Aric Lasry, ex-Dust, and Jean-Baptiste de La Fage), targeting the US. Raised a $3M pre-seed (Seedcamp, 2026-01-15) led by Seedcamp with Weekend Fund, Drysdale, Purple, OPRTRS CLUB, Firedrop, Kima, Tiny VC and angels; Businesslife reported it as €2.5M. No seed or later round found.

companies.name: Isidor
companies.description: Frontier data for frontier AI research, starting in finance

investors: angels from Google DeepMind, Perplexity, Motive, Episode 1

companies.funding_notes: Isidor (isidor.ai; contact founders@isidor.ai), London-based frontier AI data/evaluation company founded September 2025. Its own job posting says it raised an oversubscribed $3.6M pre-seed from Gradient Ventures, futurepresent and Seedcamp plus angels (Google DeepMind, Perplexity, Motive, Episode 1). Exact date not in a primary source (trackers suggest ~late 2025); lead not specified. No press release and no seed or later round found.

companies.name: Porters
companies.description: Digital back-office for banks, starting with garnishments
companies.funding_notes: Porters (withporters.com), AI-native banking back-office (account seizures/garnishments, insolvency) founded by Konstantin Kotulla, Christopher Barth and Dr Michael John (Germany/Switzerland, per Startupticker coverage). Closed €2.7M pre-seed (Tech.eu 2026-02-11) led by Earlybird with Seedcamp and fintech angels (Upvest, Qonto, Penta, Metaco founders). No seed or later round found.

companies.name: Andel
companies.description: Benefit provider building a fairer way to get life-changing drugs
companies.funding_notes: Andel Co-op, Inc. (andel.org, cited in its PR Newswire release), NYC-based cooperative employer-supported medication marketplace (GLP-1s), co-founded by Jay Bregman (ex-Hailo, Thimble) and Ritu Malhotra, PharmD. Announced a $4.5M raise at HLTH on 2025-10-20 from Lightbank, Seedcamp, BHI, Houghton Street Ventures, Springboard Health Angels, Semper Virens and Citylight. The press release does not name the round type; AlleyWatch's interview with the CEO calls it a seed round of $4.5M, so classified seed+ on that basis. Founder's post describes Lightbank, Seedcamp and BHI as leads. No later round found.

companies.name: Catch
companies.description: AI Executive assistant
companies.funding_notes: Catch (catchagent.ai), AI executive assistant (email, scheduling, travel) founded by Nir (ex-Entrée Capital investor) and Yoav Ramon (ex-CTO Nym Health); Israel-linked team. Emerged from stealth ~2026-09-02 with a $5M seed co-led by Entrée Capital and Pitango with Seedcamp and Factorial Capital.

companies.name: Omniscient
companies.description: Understand your reputation, risks and supply chain
companies.funding_notes: Omniscient (omniscient.so), Paris-based executive decision/reputation intelligence platform founded by ex-McKinsey Arnaud d'Estienne and Mehdi Benseghir. Raised $4.1M pre-seed (Tech.eu 2026-04-02) led by Seedcamp with Drysdale, Plug and Play, MS&AD, Raise, Anamcara and xdeck, plus support from Bpifrance (form of Bpifrance support, e.g. grant/loan, not specified, so not listed as a grant). No seed or later round found.

companies.name: La Fraise Pro
companies.description: AI agents to simplify dentists' admin, payments and treatment plans
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain lafraise.pro (Paris dental AI agents). Public €3.2M seed announced Nov 2025; Seedcamp participated alongside 20VC, Kima Ventures and dentists (lead not stated in Seedcamp post; some secondary coverage calls 20VC lead). TheSaaSNews also notes a Bpifrance loan (not counted as equity). Used by 1,200+ dentists in France at announcement.

companies.name: Opio
companies.description: Frontier AI for transaction services
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain opio.fi (Paris; AI for financial transaction-services / due diligence). Came out of stealth with €4M first/seed round Sep 2026 from Frst, Seedcamp and GFC plus angels (Pennylane CEO Arthur Waller, Dust co-founder Stanislas Polu). Customers include Forvis Mazars and BDO; active in 15 countries.

companies.name: Wexler
companies.description: AI agents for litigation document analysis
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain wexler.ai (London litigation AI). $5.3M seed Sep 2025 led by Pear VC with Seedcamp, The LegalTech Fund and pre-seed lead Myriad. Pre-seed amount in 2024 not publicly disclosed, so equity total is at least $5.3M. Customers include Clifford Chance, HSF Kramer, Goodwin, Addleshaw Goddard.

companies.name: TimeTrace Labs
companies.description: AI for real-world systems where data is limited and decisions cannot wait
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain timetracelabs.com (AI for real-world / limited-data systems). Nordic9 reports a Dec 2025 seed with Seedcamp, Fly Ventures and Paul Forster; it also lists ~$3.98M round value, but that figure appears tracker-derived (no company/PR/reputable press amount found), so amount left empty. Domain matches Seedcamp portfolio description.

companies.name: Function Health
companies.description: Membership-based health platform for clinical testing, diagnostics and MRI scans
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain functionhealth.com (Austin consumer health labs/MRI membership). Series A Jun 2024 led by a16z brought cumulative funding to $53M (Series A size itself not separately disclosed). Oversubscribed $298M Series B Nov 2025 led by Redpoint at $2.5B valuation; Seedcamp invested via Select Fund after Function acquired Seedcamp Day-One portfolio company Ezra. Public equity total treated as $53M (through Series A) + $298M Series B = $351M.

companies.name: Outpost Bio
companies.description: The first foundation model for microbiome-drug interactions
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain outpost.bio (microbiome/drug-interaction foundation models). $3.5M pre-seed Mar 2026 co-led by Merantix Capital and Seedcamp with OpenSeed, Defined and angels. Pre-seed only — does not qualify as seed+.

companies.name: BioOrbit
companies.description: Pharma factories in microgravity for cancer drugs you can inject at home
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain bioorbit.space (UK; microgravity protein crystallisation for injectable biologics). £9.8M ($13.2M) seed Apr 2026 co-led by LocalGlobe and Breega with Seedcamp, Auxxo, Type One, 7percent and angel Phil Chambers; described as largest seed for space manufacturing. Baby BOX-E unit launching to ISS. UK Space Agency / MHRA / CAA support noted (not quantified as equity).

companies.name: Topograph
companies.description: Next generation international data and document KYB provider
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain topograph.co (French KYB/business-register data API). €2M seed Mar 2026 led by Seedcamp with Drysdale, Motier, Kima and Better Angle. Covers ~40 countries; founded by ex-1POINT6 (BNP Paribas PSP) team.

companies.name: Tano
companies.description: AI-powered engine that recruits, manages and scales influencer campaigns
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain tano.ai (London AI influencer/affiliate marketing; TANO AI LTD, Companies House 16270640). Seedcamp Nov 2025 Day-One 'inception' / angel round led with The Players Fund and Operators & Friends — no public amount in Seedcamp post. Companies House shows a Jan 2026 share allotment (SH01) but the filing summary does not disclose cash raised. Tracker claims of a £3.7M seed were not verified from primary sources, so amount left empty and status remains pre-seed/angel only.

companies.name: Dalton
companies.description: Transforming AI research into drug discovery impact
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain DaltonTX.com / daltontx.com (London AI drug-discovery platform; Oxford/AstraZeneca/Exscientia founders). Company PR and Seedcamp announce £4M seed Sep 2025; lead investor redalpine’s own post cites £4.1M. Investors: redalpine (lead), IQ Capital, Seedcamp, OUI support. Used £4,000,000 from company PR.

companies.name: Motley
companies.description: Automate business reporting and communication for customer success teams
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain motley.ai (Zurich; AI business reporting for CS/ops). $1.5M pre-seed Nov 2025 led by Seedcamp with Tiny VC, Kima, RTP Global, Founders AS and angels. Pre-seed only — not seed+.

companies.name: Massive Dynamic
companies.description: AI-powered copilot for marketing orchestration
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain massive-dynamic.ai (Paris AI marketing orchestration; ex-Voodoo/Qonto founders). €3M pre-seed Jul 2025 led by Seedcamp with Founders Future, Tiny Supercomputer, Purple, OPRTRS Club, New Renaissance Ventures and Kima. Pre-seed only.

companies.name: Memories
companies.description: Visual memory model for rich context video understanding
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain memories.ai (Bay Area; Large Visual Memory Model; Meta Reality Labs alumni founders). $8M seed Jul 2025 led by Susa with Samsung Next, Fusion, Crane, Seedcamp, Creator Ventures; TechCrunch Mar 2026 reports additional $8M extension (total $16M) with Susa, Seedcamp, Fusion, Crane. Nvidia GTC collaboration announced.

companies.name: Kerys
companies.description: High performance virtualization to consolidate environments on a single machine
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain kerys.software (Paris secure virtualisation / YS::Desktop & YS::Cloud). €6.2M pre-seed Jul 2025; Seedcamp participated alongside Daphni, Backtrace, Kima and angels (no clear single lead in Seedcamp/Tech.eu). Pre-seed only — large check but not priced seed+. CEA LIST certification partnership noted (not a grant amount).

companies.name: Murphy
companies.description: AI agent for debt collection services
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain getmurphy.ai (Barcelona AI debt-servicing agents). Came out of stealth Jul 2025 with $15M across pre-seed and seed (EU-Startups cites €12.8M equivalent) led by Northzone with ElevenLabs, Lakestar, Seedcamp and Enzo. Split between pre-seed vs seed not publicly broken out; counts as seed+ because a seed tranche is included.

companies.name: Kraka
companies.description: Train factory employees in VR to complete any task on the shop floor
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain gokraka.com (Kraka Technologies GmbH; VR/AI factory employee training). Listed as Seedcamp portfolio; no reputable press release or company announcement of a priced pre-seed/seed round or amount found (trackers mention Seedcamp and Felix Jahn Beteiligungen without disclosed terms). Accelerator check alone does not count as priced seed.

companies.name: Nopan
companies.description: Centralised settlement for all major A2A payments
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain nopan.com (Amsterdam A2A/wallet payment performance; ex-Netflix payments founders). Company says €7.2M raised to date including a new round led by Newion with follow-on from Crane and Seedcamp (Jul 2026); Seedcamp/Newion frame as seed. Individual prior vs latest tranche sizes not broken out. Holds DNB licence; EPI Principal Member for Wero.

companies.name: Plakar
companies.description: Data protection and backup platform for the cloud
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain plakar.io. Paris-based open-source backup/restore platform (co-founders Julien Mangeard, Gilles Chehade). Raised $3M pre-seed in May 2025 led by Seedcamp with HelloWorld, Kima Ventures, OPRTRS and angels including Olivier Pomel (Datadog), Solomon Hykes (Docker), Alexandre Yazdi (Voodoo). No later priced equity round found publicly.

companies.name: Zenline AI
companies.description: AI for category teams in retail to make fast, shopper-centric assortment decisions
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain tryzenline.ai. Swiss AI startup for retail assortment decisions (CEO Arber Sejdiji). Raised $1.6M pre-seed in August 2025 led by Seedcamp with Yellow, First Momentum, and Arc Investors. No later priced seed+ round found publicly.

companies.name: SE3
companies.description: Make computers understand the 3D world
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain se3.ai (SE3 Labs GmbH, Munich). Spatial AI for autonomous systems/defence (co-founders Lukas Köstler, Simon Klenk, Daniel Cremers). CEO confirmed €5.5M raise to Resilience Media (Jun 2026) from Lakestar, Seedcamp, EWOR, Sequoia Scout Fund, Plug and Play, TwinTrack and others; Tech.eu confirms backers but not the euro amount. Round characterized as seed/stealth exit. Working with Bundeswehr.

companies.name: Doczen
companies.description: AI platform for commodity operators and traders
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain doczen.com. AI platform for commodity operators/traders (founders Daniel Volkenstein, Martijn Verbove). Seedcamp led a pre-seed round (announced Dec 2025; Nordic9 dates Nov 2025) with Rerail, Anamcara, Nordstar, Indicator Fund and strategic angels. Seedcamp/company materials do not publish a round amount; Nordic9 lists ~$677k total investments but round value N/A — left amount empty rather than invent.

companies.name: Volter
companies.description: Commercial energy site management and aggregation
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain getvolter.com. London commercial solar/energy OS for real estate (co-founder Luke Buhl-Nielsen). Raised $3.2M pre-seed in Nov 2024 led by Transition with Seedcamp and Neptunia. No later priced seed+ round found publicly. (Some trackers label it seed; contemporaneous Tech.eu/Seedcamp call it pre-seed.)

companies.name: Powernaut
companies.description: Virtual power plant for consumers' smart device installations
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain powernaut.io. Belgian (Ghent) VPP/orchestration software for decentralised energy devices (co-founders Florentijn Degroote, Serge Morel). Raised €2.4M pre-seed in Dec 2024 led by Revent with Seedcamp, Pitchdrive, and Syndicate One. No later priced seed+ round found publicly.

companies.name: Source.dev
companies.description: Platform for smart devices to make simple, bug-free and cost effective software updates
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain source.dev. London AI-native DevOpsSec / smart-device software-update platform. 515 Ventures portfolio page lists Source.dev as Pre-seed; Episode1 and Seedcamp also appear as investors on secondary sites. No BusinessWire/TechCrunch/Seedcamp press release with a published amount found; PitchBook/Dealroom figures (~$3.3M) not used. Amount left empty.

companies.name: Linkup
companies.description: AI search engine optimized for LLMs and agents
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain linkup.so. French AI-native web search for LLMs/agents (co-founders Philippe Mizrahi, Denis Charrier, Boris Toledano). Nov 2024: Seedcamp-led €3M round with Axeleo, Motier, Kima. Feb/Mar 2026: $10M seed led by Gradient with Elaia, Leblon, Weekend Fund, existing investors and angels (Datadog/Mistral/Deel/Dataiku founders). Gradient described the prior round as a small seed. Mixed-currency total left unconverted.

companies.name: Umony
companies.description: Capturing, archiving and monitoring regulated communications
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain umony.com. London AI communications compliance for regulated industries (founders Dean Elwood, Anna Pitt-Stanley). Series A $15M led by Notion Capital (Sep 2025) with Seedcamp, Crane, and angel Thomas Wolf (Hugging Face). Seedcamp backed from first round; earlier pre-seed with Seedcamp/Crane has no public amount (Nordic9 round value N/A). amount_raised reflects Series A only; prior equity undisclosed.

companies.name: Miru Labs
companies.description: Miru is an AI-assisted data investigation platform to super-charge threat hunting.
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain miru-labs.com. Bay Area AI-assisted cybersecurity investigation platform (founders Eoghan McKee, Quang Pham, David Pigott). $2.7M pre-seed in Sep 2025 co-led by Seedcamp, Dreamcraft, and Cadenza with Inovia, Notion, Alphagraph. No later priced seed+ round found. (Nordic9 also lists Plug and Play; Seedcamp announcement does not.)

companies.name: Singulate
companies.description: The first generative AI personalization email marketing platform
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain singulate.com. Generative AI email marketing personalization (co-founders Dave Schools, Nicolas Klein, John O'Gara; ex-Hopin). $2.3M pre-seed Oct 2024 led by Bowery Capital with Seedcamp and angels. Baltimore/US. No later priced seed+ round found.

companies.name: Ciao
companies.description: Helping people live flexibly
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain meetciao.com. UK flexible living / home-sharing marketplace; Seedcamp portfolio (2024). No TechCrunch, Seedcamp funding post, BusinessWire, or Companies House–cited round with a public amount found. Secondary trackers (e.g. GP Intel) claim True Seed Fund I ownership since 2024 — treated as unverified; not counted as a priced equity round.

companies.name: Stackfix
companies.description: AI-powered software comparison platform
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain stackfix.com. London AI software comparison/review platform (founders Paddy Stobbs, Camin McCluskey). $3M seed Dec 2024 led by Chalfen Ventures with Seedcamp, helloworld, and angels. Some UK coverage cites ~£2.4M equivalent.

companies.name: Digital Iron
companies.description: Boost parts sales and after-sales revenue for heavy machinery dealerships
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain digitaliron.com. AI copilot for heavy-machinery dealerships (co-founders Ciaran Gillen, Salina Brown). $2M pre-seed Jun 2024 led by Seedcamp with Concept Ventures, RTP Global, FJ Labs (FinSMEs also cites ~£1.6M). No later priced seed+ round found.

companies.name: Vaire
companies.description: Near-zero energy chips
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain vaire.co (Vaire Computing; London/Seattle; founders Rodolfo Rosini, Hannah Earley). Energetik Ventures portfolio news (Jan 2025) states seed total reached $10M with Lifeline Ventures joining — primary dedicated press for the extension is thinner than the TechCrunch piece; amount_raised uses the $10M investor-reported total. Reversible/near-zero-energy chips.

companies.name: Freqens
companies.description: Identify savings and secure the best buying conditions
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain freqens.com. Paris B2B cost-benchmarking for indirect purchases (co-founders Maxime Liebens, Richard Gozlan, Alexandre Barreira). No later priced seed+ round found.
